Emberfall for Android, build {{VERSION}}.

**Install on your phone**

1. Tap **Emberfall-{{VERSION}}.apk** below to download it.
2. Open the download. If Android asks, allow Chrome to install apps (**Settings → Allow from this source**), then go back and tap **Install**.
3. If Play Protect says it doesn't recognise the app, tap **Install anyway**. Apps from outside the Play Store always get that warning.

Already have Emberfall? Installing this version over the old one keeps your save.

**Why the Android app instead of the web version?** Reminders. Android can wake Emberfall at 9:00 even when it's closed, and a website can't. After installing, go to **Settings → Reminders** and tap **Allow reminders**.

[What's in the game](https://github.com/theratbatbose/Emberfall#whats-in-it)
